objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, invalidated, reactivated, and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of the document in the status network or workflow.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a released document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification for documents; can have templates and validity/archive settings.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document abbreviations.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for which a validity check is necessary.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating a new document object for a document type.

objs.name: person
objs.description: User involved as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator, or distribution recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for reader access, authorizations, archive access, distribution, and role selection lists.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled dependent document released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object for a document released and published directly through properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document, managed in the document cockpit.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed by workflow.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request for AKS or out-of-force declaration for a selected released document.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature completed by workflow participants and documented for released versions.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, review, acknowledgement, validity extension, override, reactivation, or translation.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of released document content.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where a document can be specified as visible or not.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type/template.

evts.name: maintain_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific document metadata and authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations to document properties.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add Additional Info to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an Attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the 3-step release process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and releases the document.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: Review or release participant rejects, cancelling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is changed or revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of the assigned Change proposal, after which it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before the Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the validity extension request, and update Valid Until.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version because the document needs to be revised.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for AKS or Override for a selected document.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, archive it, revoke rights except archive group, and keep the request for documentation.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, create a new version, restore authorizations and distribution list, and reactivate attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign User Groups and persons to Distribution for a document.

evts.name: notify_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by email notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by email upon release for persons and User Groups on the distribution list.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated language version with workflow support.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition and reference the original document.
